east_catalysts_risks.notes: Thin window: only two in-window items verified (Trade Brains 13 and 14 Oct 2026; SEO finance blog, weakest tier; the Cushman & Wakefield Q3 data is second-hand, and I did not reach the original report). Not found in window: Asianet Hoodi 321-trees story, Trade Brains Bellandur-Panathur IT boom (2026-10-12), no official BMRCL/BDA/NHAI/RERA pages fetched. The Devanahalli accident lead (thehindu.com) was blocked and is not relevant to property. No in-window news found on lake flooding, Cauvery supply, suburban rail, STRR/BBC, or OMR/Hoskote metro; the latest on these are pre-window background (e.g., BWSSB July 2026 warning of 5–6 months' reserves without rain; Citizen Matters PRR/STRR piece from Aug 2024, stale). Sarjapur–Hebbal approval was 'expected by October' per July report; no confirmation seen. Site-targeted searches on thehindu/TOI/HT/NIE/moneycontrol were rejected by the tool.

east_launches_prices.notes: Thin window: only Trade Brains items (Oct 12 and Oct 14) were found in the window, and they are SEO/finance content with unnamed price sources and inconsistent figures (e.g., Marathahalli 1-yr +51.4%; Panathur figures differ from the June article). No in-window developer launch, RERA listing, or official announcement for East Bengaluru was found. The Oct 13 'Next Whitefield' Trade Brains piece and the Asianet Hoodi substation tree-felling story (321 trees) were not found by search, so they are unverified. The Devanahalli accident lead is not relevant to residential markets. The C&W Q3 2026 report was not located, so the 56% East share rests on Trade Brains alone. The RERA portal was not checked, so no RERA numbers are portal-verified. Developer-marketing pages seen in searches (Purva Gunjur Rise, Prestige Evergreen, Brigade Gunjur, Godrej Whitefield) were undated or aggregator-sourced and were not reported.

government_watch.notes: Thin window. Deccan Herald pages returned 403, so the BDA Karanth Layout extension to 31 Oct noon (DH, 14 Oct) and the GBA 'maps not online' headline rest on search snippets and secondary sources only. Not located despite searches: TOI story on HC warning BDA, Prop News Time 'RERA bars passing project costs', LiveLawBiz REAT ₹2.45 lakh, Urban Acres Pink Line March 2027 (search results indicate March 2027 is for the underground Dairy Circle–Nagawara section; the elevated section awaits CMRS authorisation). The YourStory '400 km by 2037' claim was not confirmed; found 312 km figure instead. No official-agency pages (BMRCL, RERA, KIADB, BWSSB, NHAI) surfaced in window. Items like Prestige Q2 ₹7,225 crore, Magicbricks demand, Varthur/Panathur appreciation were not verified and are outside the government focus.

market_baseline.notes: Baseline evidence is thin on primary sources: ANAROCK Q1/Q2 2026 PDFs were unreadable via fetch; JLL blogs, Deccan Herald and Statesman returned 403. Excerpts for Q2/Q3 2026 items are text relayed by the fetch tool, not confirmed against the original pages. Not found: Bengaluru-specific Q3 2026 unsold inventory, PropEquity Q3 2026 Bengaluru, rental yield from research houses (only developer/portal blogs with conflicting figures, e.g. Whitefield 3.2-7%), NHB RESIDEX, and plotted land-rate series from transactions. Knight Frank H1 2026 Bengaluru figures (27,968 sales, 34,749 launches, Rs 9,354/sqft) were seen only via a weak republisher (MGS Architecture) and so are not reported as claims. PropTiger Q2 2026 Rs 9,931/sqft (+26%) was in search summary only. Methodologies differ across ANAROCK, PropEquity, Knight Frank and PropTiger; do not compare directly.

north_south_west.notes: The Hindu, New Indian Express, ET and Moneycontrol were blocked, so I could not read the original articles for these leads. They are unverified: the GBA Bannerghatta Road junction DPR (13–14 Oct), the Finance Department concerns on the Hebbal tunnel, Tejasvi Surya's 'unscientific' remark, the Jalahalli Cross underpass, the Mysuru Road bridge and the Swan Realty Bodhi launch in Jayanagar. Jayanagar is outside this task's focus. The Surya remark appears to be a recurring criticism: search results show 2025 and June 2026 versions. Search snippets say the cabinet approved Rs 2,215 crore for the Hebbal tunnel and the Mehkri Circle elevated corridor, and that the tunnel contract (about Rs 1,140 crore) was awarded in June to Rithwik Projects and AMRIL. These came from Deccan Herald via search only, so I did not claim them. The Devanahalli fatal accident (BJP worker, 14 Oct) is not real-estate relevant. No Electronic City, Hosur Road, Kanakapura Road, Kengeri or Tumkur Road items were found inside the window. Prestige Springwood (Devanahalli) was reported by blogs as an October 2026 launch, with RERA not filed as of June; this is unverified.

social_signals.notes: No public Reddit, YouTube or LinkedIn content dated 12-15 Oct 2026 about East Bengaluru property was found. Reddit was blocked in WebFetch. YouTube returned no listings. LinkedIn needs a login. Searches returned only developer, broker and portal blogs (Sobha, Brigade, Godrej, OneCity and similar). These are interested-party marketing and none is dated in the window. The only metro items found were August 2026 reports: Blue Line trial runs targeted for October, and the full corridor delayed to about March 2028. They are outside the window and I did not record them as claims. The one background claim is dated May 2026. Result: nothing new in the window from social platforms.
